result.summary: Round-3 design closure passes. Both round-2 findings are substantively fixed; no additional material product or security blocker was demonstrated. Existing owner decisions remain dispatch preconditions.

Disabling eviction reproduced the authorization defect. Admission, duplicate wrote paths, processed accounting and subsequent ledger selection matched.

C2-2 verified: mocked timing reproduced 1→5 and 5→1 admission shifts, including a projected run with no deadline deferrals. The revised guarantees require both runs to avoid deadline deferral; the scoped sweep found no remaining material unconditional admission/F1 guarantee.

Executed: real existing transcript parsers and streaming reader, collector, CLI disk-map rebuild, scratch hashing/integrity, validator and ledger functions with mocked filesystem/discovery/clock. Proposed primary extraction and collector substitutions ran only in memory; parsePrimaryWithOutcome is not implemented.

Machinery/citations: no material blocker found. Checked operational citations resolve, including promote.js:1397-1400. The appended dream-collect test probe does not invalidate them.
